_note: QA and CI held byte-identical copies of all five namespaces at capture time.

annotations.description: An increase in 5xx errors that may indicate an issue with mitxonline

rules.expr: sum(rate({cluster="applications-production", namespace="mitxonline", container="nginx"} | pattern `<client> - - [<_>] "<method> <uri> <_>" <status> <bytes> "<referer>" "<agent>" "<_>"` | status=~"5.." [5m])) / sum(rate({cluster="applications-production", namespace="mitxonline", container="nginx"} | pattern `<client> - - [<_>] "<method> <uri> <_>" <status> <bytes> "<referer>" "<agent>" "<_>"` [5m])) * 100 > 5

annotations.description: cert-manager in {{ $labels.cluster }} cannot reach the ACME issuer outside of the expected pod startup initialization window. Certificate renewals are blocked in this environment.
annotations.resolution: Check cert-manager pod logs and verify network connectivity to the ACME API. May indicate a network policy, DNS resolution failure, or a misconfigured ClusterIssuer credential.

annotations.description: cert-manager in {{ $labels.cluster }} is failing to present ACME DNS-01 challenges. Certificate issuance will fail until resolved.
annotations.resolution: Check IAM permissions for the Route 53 hosted zone used by the cert-manager challenge solver and verify the ClusterIssuer DNS provider configuration.

annotations.description: cert-manager in {{ $labels.cluster }} cannot reach the ACME issuer outside of the expected pod startup initialization window. All certificate renewals are blocked until resolved.
annotations.resolution: Check cert-manager pod logs and verify network connectivity to the ACME API. May indicate a network policy, DNS resolution failure, or a misconfigured ClusterIssuer credential.

annotations.description: cert-manager in {{ $labels.cluster }} is failing to present ACME DNS-01 challenges. Certificate issuance will fail until resolved.
annotations.resolution: Check IAM permissions for the Route 53 hosted zone used by the cert-manager challenge solver and verify the ClusterIssuer DNS provider configuration.

annotations.description: Redis is returning OOM errors to edxapp in {{ $labels.environment }}.
annotations.resolution: Check on the {{ $labels.environment }} redis cluster in the AWS console and resize if needed.

rules.expr: sum by(application,environment)(count_over_time({application="edxapp", environment=~".*production"} |json |= "OOM command not allowed when used memory"[15m]) >= 1)

annotations.description: Redis is returning OOM errors to edxapp in {{ $labels.environment }}.

rules.expr: sum by(application,environment)(count_over_time({application="edxapp", environment!~".*production"} |json |= "OOM command not allowed when used memory"[15m]) >= 1)

rules.expr: sum by(application,environment)(count_over_time({application="edxapp", environment=~".*production"} |json |= "Access denied for user"[15m]) >= 1)

annotations.description: edxapp {{ $labels.environment }} is having trouble communicating with the forum service.
annotations.resolution: This typically means that forum is having difficulty talking to MongoAtlas. Check on forum containers and initiate an instance refresh if necessary.

rules.expr: sum by (application, environment) (count_over_time({environment=~".*production", application="edxapp"} |json  |= "Read timed out" |="forum"[1h])) >= 1

annotations.description: A SAML configuration error has been detected in {{ $labels.application }} {{ $labels.environment }}.
annotations.resolution:
ssh into an instance and execute the following
sudo su - edxapp -s /bin/bash
source edxapp_env 
python edx-platform/manage.py lms saml --pull
Takes several minutes to resolve

rules.expr: (sum by(application,environment)(count_over_time({environment=~".*production", application="edxapp"} |= "No SAMLProviderData found for provider"[1h])) > 1)

annotations.description: A SAML configuration error has been detected in {{ $labels.application }} {{ $labels.environment }}.

Takes several minutes to resolve

rules.expr: (sum by(application,environment)(count_over_time({environment!~".*production", application="edxapp"} |= "No SAMLProviderData found for provider"[1h])) > 1)

annotations.description: High rate of 500 errors on mitxonline-production.

rules.expr: sum(count_over_time(({application="edxapp", environment="mitxonline-production"} | json | container_name=~`.*-caddy-.*` | line_format "{{.message}}" | json | status >= 500)[5m])) > 100

annotations.description: A Vault or Consul template is attempting to retrieve a secret that doesn't exist. Investigate the possibility of a misconfiguration or an accidentally deleted value.

rules.expr: count by (environment) (count_over_time({application="edxapp"} | json | SYSLOG_IDENTIFIER="vault" |~ "no secret exists"[5m])) > 0

annotations.description: A Vault client is having errors authenticating against the vault servers.

rules.expr: count by (environment) (count_over_time({application="edxapp"} | json | SYSLOG_IDENTIFIER="vault" |~ "error authenticating"[5m])) > 0
